issue_1.description: Original relative_from_cold fields use first post-step t=5ms pose, not true t0 birth. Corrected values saved separately from actual t0 state.

issue_2.description: scene_declaration.json has a nominal cold_jaw_angle_rad=.25 for every scene. Per-attempt declaration.json, summary.json and cold_state.npz contain the actual qstart.

contact_time_alignment: Recorded contact geometry and solved forces belong to incoming state t-5ms; stored completed qpos/relative pose belong to t. Both are retained and independently checked.
